title: Shared definitions
description: Reusable definitions. Not an object contract: nothing validates against this directly. Restating these constraints per-schema would let them drift.

run_id.description: ULID, Crockford Base32. Excludes I, L, O, U so a transcribed id cannot be misread.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC. Both `format` and `pattern` are declared, deliberately: `format` is annotation-only in JSON Schema and is NOT enforced unless a validator is explicitly configured with a format checker. A timestamp constrained only by `format` would be validated by some consumers and not others, which is worse than no constraint. The pattern is what every validator enforces; the format keyword remains for tooling that reads it.
